yamlCheck.explanation: The few-day recovery and dated travel/visit sequence fit January 20–30. The undated opening night and approximate early recovery do not independently establish an exact ten-boundary total. The January 28 overnight, additional day and January 30 anchor supply the closing interval explicitly; historical visions, overlapping tree growth and future plans add no adventure days.
